action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
# Re-fetch wizard to get fresh CSRF (resumes at step 3)
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt --max-time 10 http://localhost:8080/admin/bootstrap -o step3b.html
grep -o 'id="bootstrap-step-[0-9]"' step3b.html
CSRF=$(grep -o 'name="_csrf_token" value="[^"]*"' step3b.html | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt -e "http://localhost:8080/admin/bootstrap" --max-time 15 \
  --data-urlencode "_csrf_token=$CSRF" \
  --data-urlencode "oidc_user_id_claim=name" \
  --data-urlencode "oidc_displayname_claim=name" \
  --data-urlencode "oidc_email_claim=email" \
  --data-urlencode "matrix_oidc_extra_scopes=email profile groups" \
  --data-urlencode "admin_oidc_extra_scopes=email profile groups" \
  --data-urlencode "matrix_oidc_refresh_mode=offline" \
  --data-urlencode "admin_oidc_refresh_mode=online" \
  -o step3b_resp.html -D step3b_h.txt -w "step3b POST: [%{http_code}]\n" http://localhost:8080/admin/bootstrap/step/3
grep -i location step3b_h.txt
